answer: Quadratic voting flattens sybil headcount. Influence equals the square root of earned standing, so a willow farm of thin cedar clones packs less punch than their roster suggests. Plot them on the reputation atlas and the cluster shrinks toward one controller's true weight. Example: 81 clones at 1 point each vote like 9; one agent at 81 points votes like 9—spawning fakes barely moves the needle.
